sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:26

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:26:1
items.html: Yod-Hey is His name, etc., to allude how the name HaVaYaH emerged from Him: For this is the intention of the verse, “extol Him who rides upon the Aravot.” Aravot alludes to the secret of the mingling of the measure of mercy with judgement, whose beginning was made in the Partzufim of the second expansion. And he says “Yod-Hey is His name,” for in Yod-Hey, which is the secret of Keter, there was as yet no mingling; and even so there was drawn from it the HaVaYaH of the second expansion, and all the rest of the Partzufim down to the world of Atzilut, where the mingling was completed and ten vessels emerged. And this is the whole cause for giving a good reward to the righteous, as written above (Part 4, Chapter 1, item 4, in the Inner Light); study it there well. And this is the measure of the verse “extol Him who rides upon the Aravot” — that He mingled and joined the measure of mercy with judgement, and this emerged from the secret of “Yod-Hey is His name,” which is in Keter, which is the secret of expansion and departure, as above. And by this, “and rejoice before Him,” for by this all the good reward was prepared and stored up for the righteous. As explained.
